description: GPS speed, motion-state logger and waypoints for vehicles (port of the JP226 ESP32 logger)

store.summary: GPS logger with IMU, waypoint photos, setup and read-only OBD scan
store.description: Logs GPS tracks to daily CSV files using the JP226 ESP32 logger's timing and unchanged 63-column telemetry schema. Reads the CardputerZero BMI270 IMU, captures camera photos for waypoints even without a GPS fix, and records road, surface, tyre pressure, suspension and load settings. Includes a read-only OBD-II scanner with common adapter links and automatic protocol detection, plus a two-dinosaur Dino Dash.
